testimonials.title: Why We Chose Laxmi for Our AAC Plant
testimonials.subtitle: SATYAM BUILDTECH PVT. LTD. · WADA, MAHARASHTRA

hero.headline: We had already operated a Chinese AAC plant. For our larger second plant, we chose Laxmi.
hero.subheadline: A 300,000 m³/year plant at Wada, Maharashtra — delivering 100% capacity utilisation since 2020.

overview.heading: Part 1 — Testimonial Overview
overview.quote: We had already operated a Chinese AAC plant. For our larger second plant, we chose Laxmi.
body: After operating a 100,000 m³/year Chinese-supplied AAC plant, we evaluated multiple suppliers from India and China for our new 300,000 m³/year plant at Wada.

We selected Laxmi for its advanced technology and superior engineering. The plant has delivered 100% capacity utilisation with consistent results and, in our experience, has performed better in maintenance, production and wastage.
overview.author: Satyam Patel

full_story.heading: Part 2 — Our Complete Experience
paragraphs: Our first AAC plant, with an annual capacity of 100,000 m³, was installed at Mehsana, Gujarat, by a reputed Chinese supplier. Operating this plant gave us practical experience in AAC production, maintenance and wastage.
As the AAC block market grew, we decided to establish a second and significantly larger plant with an annual capacity of 300,000 m³ at Wada, Maharashtra.

Before selecting the supplier, we evaluated multiple AAC plant manufacturers from both India and China. Since we already had experience operating a Chinese-supplied plant, we were able to compare suppliers from the perspective of an actual plant owner.
After completing our evaluation, we selected Laxmi En-Fab Pvt. Ltd. because of its advanced technology and superior engineering solutions.

The plant supplied by Laxmi has performed exceptionally well. Based on our experience of operating both plants, the Laxmi plant has performed better than our earlier Chinese plant in three important areas: Maintenance, Production, and Control of wastage.
We have achieved 100% capacity utilisation with consistent production results at our Wada plant.
Our experience with Laxmi has extended beyond the plant's performance. Their timely delivery and outstanding after-sales service have also been highly commendable.
Based on our experience, we strongly recommend Laxmi En-Fab Pvt. Ltd. to businesses seeking a reliable AAC plant solution.
full_story.closing_quote: The plant supplied by Laxmi has been exceptional, outperforming our Chinese plant in maintenance, production and wastage. We have achieved 100% capacity utilisation with consistent results.

paragraphs: We decided to invest in a fully automated AAC plant to reduce dependence on a large skilled workforce and improve production batch consistency.

Our production consistency has improved significantly. We now run the plant with fewer skilled operators while maintaining higher production quality.
We would specifically recommend Laxmi's automation to plants that need reliable performance in real-world Indian industrial conditions.

full_story.closing_quote: Laxmi's automation works in real Indian plant conditions. That is what matters.

hero.headline: Laxmi's boiler and autoclave configuration reduced our steam cost significantly.
hero.subheadline: Better autoclave scheduling and boiler efficiency improved our operating economics.

overview.heading: Part 1 — Testimonial Overview
overview.quote: Steam cost is one of the largest operating expenses in an AAC plant. Laxmi's autoclave system has helped us manage this effectively.
body: After commissioning, Laxmi's process team worked with us to optimise our autoclave cycle scheduling. The results have meaningfully reduced our steam cost per cubic metre of production.
The autoclave pressure vessel quality and seal performance from Laxmi have also contributed to reduced steam losses.
overview.author: Plant Owner

full_story.heading: Part 2 — Our Complete Experience
paragraphs: Steam cost is one of the highest operating costs in an AAC plant. Laxmi's autoclave design has contributed to efficient steam utilisation.
After commissioning, Laxmi's process team helped us optimise our autoclave loading schedule to maximise production throughput per boiler firing cycle.
We also adjusted our boiler operating pressure settings with Laxmi's guidance. The result was a further improvement in steam utilisation efficiency.
Over our first year, we reduced our steam cost per cubic metre of AAC production compared to our initial estimates.
For investors concerned about operating costs, we would specifically recommend discussing autoclave configuration with Laxmi's engineering team before finalising the plant specification.
highlights: Lower steam cost per m3 of production
full_story.closing_quote: With Laxmi's guidance on autoclave scheduling and boiler parameters, we significantly improved our steam efficiency.
